نغتني (form VIII)
# نَغْتَنِي (naḡtanī) /naɣ.ta.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَنَى (iḡtanā)
# نَغْتَنِيَ (naḡtaniya) /naɣ.ta.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَنَى (iḡtanā)
